model.name: Ming Image 0.1 Design-Layer 6B
model.description: Separate one flattened design into transparent, individually usable image layers.

prompt:
Decompose this image into 4 layers with the following specifications:
Number of layers: 4
Layer 1: All clearly readable foreground text, preserving its exact wording and placement.
Layer 2: The card, panel, or banner directly behind the text, if present.
Layer 3: The main foreground subject or illustration.
Layer 4: The complete background with remaining supporting shapes, surfaces, patterns, and shadows.
